# Spin Interferometry Generated by Cavity Memory

## Abstract

> We report the control and observation of coherent spin interferometry generated by cavity memory
> using an ensemble of nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers coupled to a microwave cavity. The abrupt
> switch-on and switch-off of a detuned drive produce transient fields at the cavity frequency
> that supply the two spin rotations for Ramsey interferometry, observed using both microwave and
> fluorescence readout. Spectrally scanning the spin profile across the cavity and drive
> frequencies distinguishes cavity-generated Ramsey interference from conventional Rabi dynamics.
> Temporal weighting of the reflected microwave signal enables spectrally selective population
> readout at a single probe frequency. By programming the phase and amplitude of the drive
> envelope, we extend the same mechanism to more quantum control sequences, including spin-echo
> and Rabi control.
